commits.message:
refactor(repo-facts): path helpers join the repo facts; a gate keeps test/ out of non-test code (rich-repo-facts-hss)

Review pass (high) on PR #253:
- repoRelative, isPathInside, isUnderSrc and isBehindNodeAirlock move to
  scripts/repo-facts.ts, so the seam gates no longer import the coverage
  verifier for repo layout.
- test/seam/test-imports.test.ts fails when any .ts under src/, docs/,
  scripts/ or examples/ imports a module under test/.
- example-runner reads peerDependencies from PACKAGE_MANIFEST instead of
  parsing package.json a second time.
- resolveAlias no longer swallows a throw from getAliasedSymbol.
- tsconfig.scripts.json includes scripts/**/*.ts directly.

refactor(repo-facts): the docs build reads repo facts from scripts/, not test/ (rich-repo-facts-hss)

REPO_ROOT, the package manifest, the entry-point map, the repo's compiler
options and listTypeScriptFiles move from test/coverage/extract.ts to
scripts/repo-facts.ts; resolveAlias moves to scripts/resolve-alias.ts.
Every importer reads them from the new home and extract.ts re-exports
nothing, so nothing under docs/ imports from test/ and a refactor of the
coverage verifier can no longer change how the docs' examples compile.

fix(markdown): reflow soft-broken blocks and end every list item's row (rich-demos-b19) (#252)

* fix(markdown): reflow soft-broken blocks and end every list item's row (rich-demos-b19)

A list item took only its marker line; its continuation lines fell into a
paragraph that also swallowed the next items, joined untrimmed. The item
never ended its row, so what followed ran past the width and a Panel cut
it off — the rich-dash README panel lost "panel proves it is" outright.

Paragraphs, list items and quotes now each take every line up to a blank
or the next block start, joined by one space. Every wrapped block is laid
out through one gutter: a list item's text hangs under its bullet, a
quote's bar runs its full height, and a nested item keeps its indent.

* fix(markdown): CommonMark paragraph interrupts, setext headings, hard breaks, CRLF (rich-demos-b19)

Review of #252: a paragraph is interrupted only by a numbered item counting
from 1, and a = / - underline makes it a heading; lines ending in two spaces
or a backslash keep their break; CRLF input tokenizes; a bare > continues a
quote; list nesting is counted in columns so a tab never reaches the
terminal; a gutter never narrows text below one column.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(markdown): quote structure keeps its rows, list items read numbers as CommonMark, empty blocks draw (rich-demos-b19)

Review of #252: inside a quote a blank line or a block start begins a row
of its own instead of reflowing into the text around it; a numbered line
indented into a list item stays its text unless it counts from 1; an empty
item or quote still draws its bullet or bar.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(markdown): a blockquote holds blocks of its own (rich-demos-b19)

Review of #252: a quote's lines, markers cut off, are tokenized as Markdown
of their own and drawn beside the bar, so a fence, a list or a paragraph
break inside one keeps its shape, and a lazy line continues only the
paragraph open inside it. The quote-only row rules in continuation go.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
